def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    D=max(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).items(), key=lambda t:t[1])[0]      # block background
    cnt=Counter(tuple(r) for r in inp)
    top,t2=cnt.most_common(2)
    tmpl=rle=top[0][0]                              # modal full content row pattern (no separators!)
    def rows_match(row,tmpl,threshold=0.6):
        return sum(1 for a,b in zip(row,tmpl) if a==b)>=threshold*W
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if not rows_match(inp[i],tmpl)]
    sc=[]
    # separator columns: dominant per-column color != D among non-separator rows? simpler:
    clean=[inp[i] for i in range(H) if i not in sr]
    for j in range(W):
        col=[clean[i][j] for i in range(len(clean))]
        if Counter(col).most_common(1)[0][0]!=D and Counter(col).most_common(1)[0][1]>len(col)/2:
            sc.append(j)
    res=[[None]*(max(len(sc)-1,0)) for _ in range(max(len(sr)-1,0))]
    for i in range(len(sr)-1):
        a,b=inp[sr[i]],inp[sr[i+1]]
        for j in range(len(sc)-1):
            x,y=sc[j],sc[j+1]
            v=a[x]
            if a[x]==a[y]==b[x]==b[y] and v!=D and v!=inp[sr[i]][x]:
                res[i][j]=v
    return [[c if c is not None else D for c in row] for row in res]

from collections import Counter
import json
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    D=max(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).items(), key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    cnt=Counter(tuple(r) for r in inp)
    tmpl=list(cnt.most_common(1)[0][0])
    def match(row):
        return sum(1 for a,b in zip(row,tmpl) if a==b)>=int(0.6*W)
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if not match(inp[i])]                     # marked rows
    mark=[]
    for j in range(W):

from collections import Counter
import json
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    D=max(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).items(), key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    # separator lines: rows/cols whose dominant color != D
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if Counter(inp[i]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=D]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if Counter([inp[i][j] for i in range(H)]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=D]
    # keep only lines that carry at least one anomaly (non-D cell)
    def has_anom(idx): return any(inp[r][c]!=D for r in (sr if idx in ('r',) else range(H)) for c in (idx if False else [idx][:1]))
    def has_anom_row(i): return any(v!=D for v in inp[i])
    def has_anom_col(j): return any(inp[i][j]!=D for i in range(H))
    sr=[i for i in sr if has_anom_row(i)]
    sc=[j for j in sc if has_anom_col(j)]
    res=[[None]*(max(len(sc)-1,0)) for _ in range(max(len(sr)-1,0))]
    for i in range(len(sr)-1):
        a,b=inp[sr[i]],inp[sr[i+1]]
        for j in range(len(sc)-1):
            cs=[a[sc[j]],a[sc[j+1]],b[sc[j]],b[sc[j+1]]]
            if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0]!=D: res[i][j]=cs[0]
    return [[c if c is not None else D for c in row] for row in res]
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2'):
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'], f(G[k+' input']), G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter
import json
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    D=max(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).items(), key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    cnt=Counter(tuple(r) for r in inp); tmpl=list(cnt.most_common(1)[0][0])
    mrg=lambda row: sum(1 for a,b in zip(row,tmpl) if a==b)>=int(0.6*W)
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if not mrg(inp[i])]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if Counter([inp[i][j] for i in range(H)]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=D]
    res=[[None]*(max(len(sc)-1,0)) for _ in range(max(len(sr)-1,0))]

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    D=max(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).items(),key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    tmpl=Counter(tuple(r) for r in inp).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mrg=lambda row: sum(1 for a,b in zip(row,tmpl) if a==b)>=int(0.6*W)
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if not mrg(inp[i])]
    # discard separator rows without any anomaly; keep columns that have at least one mark
    sc=sorted({j for i in sr for j,v in enumerate(inp[i]) if v!=max(Counter(inp[i]).items(),key=lambda t:t[1])[0]})
    res=[[None]*(len(sc)-1) for _ in range(len(sr)-1)]
    for a,b in zip(sr,sr[1:]):
        for x,y in zip(sc,sc[1:]):
            cs=[inp[a][x],inp[a][y],inp[b][x],inp[b][y]]
            if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0]!=D: res[sr.index(a)][sc.index(x)]=cs[0]
    return [[c if c is not None else D for c in row] for row in res]
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):

    D=max(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).items(),key=lambda t:t[1])[0]

    return [[c if c is not None else D for c in row] for row in res]
